newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish military officer shot in Madrid attack.
newsitem.headline: Spanish military officer shot in Madrid attack.

text.p: A Spanish military officer was shot and possibly killed in an apparent guerrilla attack in northeastern Madrid on Wednesday, a police spokesman told state radio.
Hospital officials later confirmed that Lieutenant-Colonel Jesus Augustin Cuesta, 60, had died shortly after arriving at hospital.
Witnesses said a lone individual had approached the officer at about 3.15 p.m. (1415 GMT) in the Estrella neighbourhood of Madrid and shot him in the head.
Police did not say whether the attack was carried out by ETA Basque separatist guerrillas, but the group has often targetted members of security forces in its 28-year drive for Basque independence.
Spain's Interior Minister Jaime Mayor Oreja predicted on Tuesday that ETA (Basque Homeland and Freedom) would launch attacks in retaliation for recent police success against the group.
